faqData.question: What time should I arrive?
faqData.answer: Be there by 4pm to enjoy the pre-match booths and qualify for the raffle draw. The event will strictly begin at 5:30pm, and we don't want any defaults!

faqData.question: Can I bring a Plus One?
faqData.answer: This is a singles tournament. I have taken the time to hand-pick those who are special to me as I celebrate this milestone of my life. So, no plus ones allowed.

faqData.question: Is there Parking at the venue?
faqData.answer: There is ample parking at the Palms' premises on a first come-first serve basis.

faqData.question: Until when can I RSVP?
faqData.answer: Please RSVP on or before January 8, 2026.

faqData.question: Is there a Dress Code?
faqData.answer:
Come in your Semi-Formal Smashin' Chic Outfit. Think summer sophistication!

Womens: Tennis skirts, summer dresses, stylish jumpsuits, smart blouses with skirts/trousers, wedges, ballet flats, heels, or (clean) sneakers.

Men: Chinos, smart shirts (collared), lightweight blazers, loafers, or (clean) sneakers. No Basketball Jerseys/Shorts, and Jeans/Maong Pants.

faqData.question: Can I bring pet/s?
faqData.answer: As much as we love them, unfortunately no pets are allowed.
